text.value: You come across a freighter of Engi refugees fleeing the Rebels. Their ship is seriously damaged and they clearly need help.

options.label: You just don't have the equipment or the time to help them. We wish them luck and let them go on their way.
You give them what scrap you can afford to aid them in their repair efforts.

text.value: They thank you repeatedly and wish you good luck on your mission.

options.label: (Engi) Your crewmember wants to go aboard to see if he can provide any help personally. He requests some scrap to help.

text.value: He returns bearing good news. He was able to improve their engines and convinced one of their crew to join your cause.
